nodes.name: thm:sf_gkat_fix
nodes.statement:
\mathrm{label}{thm:sf_gkat_fix}
    For any \(r,s \in \mathsf{Det}\), \(r \equiv_* s\) if and only if \(r \equiv_*^{\det} s\).

nodes.name: lem:deterministic_fundamental_theorem
nodes.statement:
\mathrm{label}{lem:deterministic_fundamental_theorem}
	Given \(r \in \mathsf{Det}\), \(\operatorname{incl}_{\langle r\rangle} \colon \langle r \rangle \to \mathsf{StExp}\) is a deterministic solution.

nodes.name: thm:deterministic_canonical_solution
nodes.statement:
\mathrm{label}{thm:deterministic_canonical_solution}
	The canonical solution \(\varphi_X\) is a also deterministic solution to \((X,\tau)\).
	That is, for any \(x \in X\),
	\[
	\varphi_X(x) \equiv_*^{\det} \sum_{x\alpha p \checkmark} \alpha p + \sum_{x\alpha p y} \alpha p~\varphi_X(y)
	\]
	Furthermore, for any deterministic solution \(\psi\) to \((X,\tau)\) and any \(x \in X\),
	\[
	\varphi_X(x) \equiv_*^{\det} \psi(x)
	\]

nodes.name: lem:homoms_preserve_det_solutions
lem:deterministic_solution_properties
nodes.statement:
\mathrm{label}{lem:deterministic_solution_properties}
	Let \(x,z \in X\).
	\begin{enumerate}
		\item \(\varphi_X(x)\) and \(t_X(x,z)\) are deterministic expressions.
		\item If \(x \mathrel{\curvearrowright} y\), then \[
			\varphi_X(y) \equiv_*^{\det} t_X(y,x)\varphi_X(x)
		\]
		\item If \(x \mathrel{\curvearrowright} y\) and \(\psi\) is any deterministic solution to \((X,\tau)\), then \[
			\psi(y) \equiv_*^{\det} t_X(y,x)\psi(x)
		\]
	\end{enumerate}

nodes.name: thm:closure under homomorphic images
lem:determinism homom
nodes.statement:
\mathrm{label}{lem:determinism homom}
	If \(x\) is an operationally deterministic state of the LTS \((X,\tau_X)\) and \(h \colon (X,\tau_X) \to (Y,\tau_Y)\) is a homomorphism, then \(h(x)\) is operationally deterministic.
